title: Perceptual Reality Transformer: What Must an Illustration Preserve?
abstract: arXiv:2508.09852v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How can models help people communicate unusual perceptual experiences without changing what they mean? A recognizable image is only part of the answer: accounts also express vividness, duration, uncertainty, and emotion. We introduce Perceptual Reality Transformer (PRT), an evidence-linked workflow and descriptive atlas that retain the source account alongside representations and generated illustrations. Three studies examine successive parts of this transformation. In 3,145 public Ganzflicker records, frozen neural representations predict complex content well (AUROC 0.887--0.894), but vividness, persistence, and unpleasantness are less recoverable; separate imagery/context responses improve vividness prediction relative to narrative embeddings alone. translated_title: 知觉现实转换器：插图必须保留什么？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.09852v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：模型如何在不改变含义的前提下帮助人们传达不寻常的知觉体验？一张可识别的图像只是答案的一部分：叙述中还表达了生动性、持续时间、不确定性和情绪。我们提出了知觉现实转换器，这是一个证据关联的工作流程和描述性图谱，将原始叙述与表示和生成的插图一同保留下来。三项研究考察了这一转换的相继环节。在3,145条公开的Ganzflicker记录中，冻结的神经表示能较好地预测复杂内容（AUROC 0.887–0.894），但生动性、持久性和不愉悦感较难恢复；相比仅使用叙事嵌入，分离的意象/情境响应改善了生动性的预测。在672个合成对比中，相似性判断在很大程度上取决于措辞，而探索性探针能恢复一些余弦相似度难以处理的区别。最后，72个匹配的插图……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了知觉现实转换器（PRT），一个证据关联的工作流程和描述性图谱，通过将原始知觉叙述与表示和生成的插图一同保留，系统评估了在为不寻常知觉体验生成插图时哪些关键属性（如生动性、持久性和情绪）必须被保留。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Perceptual Reality Transformer (PRT), an evidence-linked workflow and descriptive atlas that retains source perceptual accounts alongside representations and generated illustrations, systematically evaluating which critical attributes—such as vividness, persistence, and emotion—must be preserved when illustrating unusual perceptual experiences.
